formulas.ascii: d_c(n+1) = (T_z / M'_z) * max(0, mean_c(d(n)) + (T_z - M_z) / A_z) for every cell c of zone z. mean_c is the focal mean of in-area neighbours (rook or box), M_z the zone mass of the smoothed surface, M'_z the zone mass after the clamp, A_z the zone cell count. Initial density is T_z / A_z.
